This '''Anooba''' resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] during the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]].

==Biography==
This [[Anooba/Legends|Anooba]] was part of a pack held at the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] prison and used in case of prison breakouts for tracking down and eliminating fugitives. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this Anooba and the rest of the pack was let loose by warden [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] to track down the squadron of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] who came to the prison to rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] who was held there for interrogation regarding the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]]. In the firefight that ensued on the planet, the pack of Anoobas were killed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], with the exception of this one which managed to sneak past the attackers and took advantage of the general chaos created to attack and kill master Even Piell. Noticing the attack, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] came to protect Piell and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to push this Anooba past a nearby cliff and into the lava below.
